intervention.description: remove the fixed 0.5 s post-success sleep in a2/synthesize.llm_chat res.ok path
intervention.claimed_effect: ~0.5 s per successful SYNTHESIZE call (10/10 baseline R526 S5 fresh battery)

post_success_sleep_s.note: post_success_sleep_s not present on this arm (pre-Q5 instrumentation build)

measured_sleep_effect.rule: the sleep effect is proven when the after arm carries post_success_sleep_s on all 10 rows with a mean < 0.05 s (the fixed 0.5 s sleep is removed); the baseline reference is the R526 S5 fresh battery (~0.5 s on 10/10 calls)

discovery_funnel_outcome.note: mechanisms_found changed materially (baseline 0 vs after 0) — this is an OBSERVED ARM CONFOUND / provider-state difference, NOT attributed to the sleep intervention (the directive section 3 rule: do not attribute that difference to the sleep; record it as a confound)

remaining_confounds.note: the after-arm SYNTHESIZE stage wall is 68.559 s vs baseline 9.819 s — this is provider-inference variance (free-tier flapping in the after window), NOT the sleep-removal effect (the sleep was ~0.5 s, ~5% of the baseline stage wall). The unattributed remainder is recorded as UNATTRIBUTED; it is NOT distributed to the intervention.

round_states.note: these five states are distinct and never collapsed. optimization_measured is TRUE only when the measured before/after sleep effect is durable (after post_success_sleep_s ~0 on 10/10 rows). The funnel confound + provider variance are recorded as UNKNOWN remainders, never forced into the intervention claim.

classification_not: NOT claimed: end-to-end discovery runtime improvement (the provider-inference variance dominates the stage wall; the 0.5 s sleep was ~5% of baseline)
NOT claimed: discovery-funnel equivalence (the mechanisms_found drop is an arm confound, not the intervention effect)
NOT claimed: the 0.5 s removal made the engine faster overall (only the sleep component is measured; provider inference is the dominant cost)

next_round.rule: the next substantive target is the constitutional funnel bottleneck (Art. LXXXIII): the largest dropout stage on the frozen battery. The MECHANISM_SPACE subphase decomposition (mechanism_attribution/1.0.0) is the next measurement to surface before any optimization is named.
